address: 99 Boulcott Street, Wellington Central, Wellington, 6011, New Zealand
bio: A firm favourite among locals for over 30 years, this classic bistro in a charming Victorian cottage is the perfect spot for casual lunches and formal dinners. The menu rolls out time-honoured bistro staples built on solid techniques and honest flavours, ranging from French onion soup and crumbed calamari to aged beef fillet in sauce béarnaise and a crème brûlée that never disappoints... Reservations only accepted for lunch and early dinner up to 6pm.
